reason: The study prospectively evaluated prediagnostic circulating metabolites and incident prostate cancer, but the abstract does not report an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal prostate cancer analysis. The 835 cases mentioned in the abstract span three cancer types and are not the total analytic participant sample.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Higher levels of lysophosphatidylcholines (lysoPCs), and especially lysoPC a C18:0, were consistently related to lower risks of breast, prostate, and colorectal cancer, independent of background factors.
estimate_classifications.reason: The abstract explicitly associates plasma lysoPC a C18:0 with incident prostate cancer risk without defining an aggressive subtype.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
